_meta.alias_language: Ukrainian morphological variants + Russian cognates where relevant
_meta.source: B4 Masnenko & Rakshanov 2012, B2 Tsapenko 1967, B1 Kosmina 2008
_meta.notes: IDs are stable ASCII keys. Ukrainian aliases are primary. Russian aliases marked [ru]. Transliterated aliases marked [translit].

KHATA_HOUSE.notes: Primary living structure. Symbolically viewed as domestic temple and model of universe.

SINY_VESTIBULE.untranslatability_note: сіни encodes threshold logic — organises entire khata spatial grammar. Russian сени is false cognate (simpler passage, no ritual register).
SINY_VESTIBULE.notes: Unheated entrance hall. Threshold category — entire khata spatial logic organised around сіни/хата distinction.

KOMORA_PANTRY.notes: Unheated storage for grain, food, textiles, tools.

PICH_STOVE.untranslatability_note: піч is a spatial zone — heats, cooks, sleeping platform, ritual centre. Russian печь is most dangerous false cognate. English stove/oven = appliance only.
PICH_STOVE.notes: Massive clay stove. Thermal, functional, ritual and spatial heart of khata. Addressed as living being or mother.

CHELIUSTI.untranslatability_note: Encodes піч as animate — the mouth of a living being. Absent from B2 entirely. English firebox opening = functional only.
CHELIUSTI.notes: Arched opening of stove. Anatomical term — encodes animate quality of піч.

PIDDUVALO.notes: Lower opening below челюсті for draft/ash. Functional element.

KOMYN_CHIMNEY.notes: Smoke-collecting hood or chimney above hearth.

CHERYN.notes: Internal floor of stove where fuel burns and food cooks.

ZAPICHOK.notes: Warm space between stove and wall. Used for sleeping or storage.

POKUT_ICON_CORNER.untranslatability_note: покуть encodes cosmological position — identified as bright heavenly star. No English equivalent preserves this.
POKUT_ICON_CORNER.notes: Sacred corner diagonally opposite stove. Most prestigious space. Cosmologically identified as bright star.

SVOLOK.untranslatability_note: сволок is simultaneously structural element + spatial orienter + Milky Way (Чумацький Шлях). Russian балка/матиця = structural only. English ceiling beam = structural only.
SVOLOK.notes: Central ceiling beam. Structural + cosmological — identified as Milky Way. Site of building sacrifice.

CEILING_BEAMS.notes: General ceiling beams (not the central svolok). Vectorless pipeline ID — kept for merge compatibility.

PIL_SLEEPING_PLATFORM.notes: Fixed wooden sleeping platform between stove and wall.

TABLE.notes: Positioned in pokut. First object brought into new house. Domestic altar for ritual meals.

BENCH_LAVA.notes: Fixed wooden bench along walls. Meets at table in pokut corner.

MYSNYK.untranslatability_note: Podillia-specific term for open dish shelf. Dropped by both pipelines from B2 — a documented extraction failure.
MYSNYK.notes: Shelf or open cupboard for ceramic dishes. Podillia-specific. Key dropped term in B2 Tsapenko.

BOZHNYTSIA.notes: Narrow shelf for icons in pokut corner.

SKRYNIA.notes: Decorated chest for dowry and finest textiles. Placed near table — signals family life-cycle stage.

ZHERDKA.notes: Horizontal rod suspended from ceiling above пол for hanging clothing. Displays family wealth.

WALL.notes: Cosmologically identified with mountains and forests.

WINDOW.notes: Peripichne window placed to illuminate cooking surface.

THRESHOLD_PORIH.untranslatability_note: поріг is site of ancestor burial and protective boundary between living and spirit world. Also project name — threshold as conceptual frame.
THRESHOLD_PORIH.notes: Physical threshold. Historically significant as site for ancestor protection and burial.

DOLIVKA.untranslatability_note: долівка is re-dressed with clay, cow dung, ochre — cosmological earth, not static material. English earthen floor = static/primitive. Absent from B2.
DOLIVKA.notes: Earthen/clay floor. Represents the earth cosmologically. Re-dressed ritually.

POBILKA.untranslatability_note: побілка is a calendar act — seasonal renewal before Easter, women's work. Russian побєлка loses ritual. English whitewash loses both material practice and ritual.
POBILKA.notes: Seasonal whitewashing. Ritual calendar act, not maintenance. Women's work.

ORNAMENTAL_FRIEZE.notes: Decorative painted band. Often at ceiling-wall junction or on стove panels.

PRYZBA.notes: Clay-packed ledge along exterior base. Insulation and social seating.

STRIKHA_ROOF.notes: Thatched roof of rye straw or reeds. Described as mother-child bond with living space.

RYNDUK.untranslatability_note: Podillia-specific covered exterior porch. Not present in standard Russian architectural vocabulary.
RYNDUK.notes: Podillia-specific exterior porch. Formally absent from current pipeline — to be added.

VANKYR.untranslatability_note: Podillia-specific term for attached outbuilding or lean-to. No Russian or English equivalent.
VANKYR.notes: Podillia-specific outbuilding. Formally absent from current pipeline — to be added.

WOVEN_TEXTILE.notes: Woven textiles including rushnyky. Displayed on zherdka — signals family wealth.
